def byteArrayRepeat (n : Nat) (b : UInt8) : ByteArray :=
  ByteArray.mk (Array.mkArray n b)

def byteArraySingleton (b : UInt8) : ByteArray :=
  ByteArray.mk #[b]

def u64ToBytesLE (v : UInt64) : ByteArray :=
  Id.run do
    let mut out := ByteArray.mk (Array.mkArray 8 (0 : UInt8))
    for i in [0:8] do
      let shift : UInt64 := UInt64.ofNat (8 * i)
      let byte : UInt8 := UInt8.ofNat (((v >>> shift) &&& (0xff : UInt64)).toNat)
      out := out.set! i byte
    return out

def u64ToBytesBE (v : UInt64) : ByteArray :=
  Id.run do
    let mut out := ByteArray.mk (Array.mkArray 8 (0 : UInt8))
    for i in [0:8] do
      let shift : UInt64 := UInt64.ofNat (8 * (7 - i))
      let byte : UInt8 := UInt8.ofNat (((v >>> shift) &&& (0xff : UInt64)).toNat)
      out := out.set! i byte
    return out

def u32ToBytesBE (v : UInt32) : ByteArray :=
  Id.run do
    let mut out := ByteArray.mk (Array.mkArray 4 (0 : UInt8))
    for i in [0:4] do
      let shift : UInt32 := UInt32.ofNat (8 * (3 - i))
      let byte : UInt8 := UInt8.ofNat (((v >>> shift) &&& (0xff : UInt32)).toNat)
      out := out.set! i byte
    return out

def bytesToUInt32BE (bs : ByteArray) (i : Nat) : UInt32 :=
  let b0 := UInt32.ofNat (bs.get! i).toNat
  let b1 := UInt32.ofNat (bs.get! (i+1)).toNat
  let b2 := UInt32.ofNat (bs.get! (i+2)).toNat
  let b3 := UInt32.ofNat (bs.get! (i+3)).toNat
  (b0 <<< (UInt32.ofNat 24)) ||| (b1 <<< (UInt32.ofNat 16)) ||| (b2 <<< (UInt32.ofNat 8)) ||| b3

def xorByteArray32 (a b : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  Id.run do
    let mut out := ByteArray.mk (Array.mkArray 32 (0 : UInt8))
    for i in [0:32] do
      out := out.set! i (a.get! i ^^^ b.get! i)
    return out

def sha256Init : Array UInt32 :=
  #[0x6a09e667, 0xbb67ae85, 0x3c6ef372, 0xa54ff53a, 0x510e527f, 0x9b05688c, 0x1f83d9ab, 0x5be0cd19]

def rotr32 (x : UInt32) (n : Nat) : UInt32 :=
  let nn := n % 32
  (x >>> (UInt32.ofNat nn)) ||| (x <<< (UInt32.ofNat (32 - nn)))

def shr32 (x : UInt32) (n : Nat) : UInt32 :=
  x >>> (UInt32.ofNat (n % 32))

def ch32 (x y z : UInt32) : UInt32 :=
  (x &&& y) ^^^ ((~~~x) &&& z)

def maj32 (x y z : UInt32) : UInt32 :=
  (x &&& y) ^^^ (x &&& z) ^^^ (y &&& z)

def bigSigma0 (x : UInt32) : UInt32 :=
  rotr32 x 2 ^^^ rotr32 x 13 ^^^ rotr32 x 22

def bigSigma1 (x : UInt32) : UInt32 :=
  rotr32 x 6 ^^^ rotr32 x 11 ^^^ rotr32 x 25

def smallSigma0 (x : UInt32) : UInt32 :=
  rotr32 x 7 ^^^ rotr32 x 18 ^^^ shr32 x 3

def smallSigma1 (x : UInt32) : UInt32 :=
  rotr32 x 17 ^^^ rotr32 x 19 ^^^ shr32 x 10

def sha256Pad (msg : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  let len := msg.size
  let bitLen : UInt64 := UInt64.ofNat (len * 8)
  let len1 := len + 1
  let rem := len1 % 64
  let zeros :=
    if rem ≤ 56 then
      56 - rem
    else
      56 + 64 - rem
  msg ++ byteArraySingleton 0x80 ++ byteArrayRepeat zeros 0 ++ u64ToBytesBE bitLen

def sha256Compress (h : Array UInt32) (chunk : ByteArray) : Array UInt32 :=
  Id.run do
    let mut w := Array.mkArray 64 (0 : UInt32)
    for i in [0:16] do
      w := w.set! i (bytesToUInt32BE chunk (4*i))
    for i in [16:64] do
      let s0 := smallSigma0 (w.get! (i-15))
      let s1 := smallSigma1 (w.get! (i-2))
      let wi := s1 + (w.get! (i-7)) + s0 + (w.get! (i-16))
      w := w.set! i wi
    let mut a := h.get! 0
    let mut b := h.get! 1
    let mut c := h.get! 2
    let mut d := h.get! 3
    let mut e := h.get! 4
    let mut f := h.get! 5
    let mut g := h.get! 6
    let mut hh := h.get! 7
    for i in [0:64] do
      let t1 := hh + bigSigma1 e + ch32 e f g + (sha256K.get! i) + (w.get! i)
      let t2 := bigSigma0 a + maj32 a b c
      hh := g
      g := f
      f := e
      e := d + t1
      d := c
      c := b
      b := a
      a := t1 + t2
    let mut out := h
    out := out.set! 0 (out.get! 0 + a)
    out := out.set! 1 (out.get! 1 + b)
    out := out.set! 2 (out.get! 2 + c)
    out := out.set! 3 (out.get! 3 + d)
    out := out.set! 4 (out.get! 4 + e)
    out := out.set! 5 (out.get! 5 + f)
    out := out.set! 6 (out.get! 6 + g)
    out := out.set! 7 (out.get! 7 + hh)
    return out

def sha256Digest (h : Array UInt32) : ByteArray :=
  Id.run do
    let mut out := ByteArray.empty
    for i in [0:8] do
      out := out ++ u32ToBytesBE (h.get! i)
    return out

def sha256 (msg : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  Id.run do
    let padded := sha256Pad msg
    let n := padded.size / 64
    let mut h := sha256Init
    for i in [0:n] do
      let start := i * 64
      let chunk := padded.extract start (start + 64)
      h := sha256Compress h chunk
    return sha256Digest h

def shaUpdateU64LE (m : ByteArray) (v : UInt64) : ByteArray :=
  m ++ u64ToBytesLE v

def shaUpdateBytes (m : ByteArray) (b : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  shaUpdateU64LE m (UInt64.ofNat b.size) ++ b

def hexDigitLower (n : Nat) : Char :=
  if h : n < 10 then
    Char.ofNat (n + 48)
  else
    Char.ofNat (n - 10 + 97)

def byteToHexLower (b : UInt8) : String :=
  let n := b.toNat
  let hi := n / 16
  let lo := n % 16
  String.mk [hexDigitLower hi, hexDigitLower lo]

def bytesToHexLower (bs : ByteArray) : String :=
  bs.foldl (fun acc b => acc ++ byteToHexLower b) ""

structure Prng where
  state : UInt64
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def prngNextU64 (p : Prng) : UInt64 × Prng :=
  let s := p.state + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15
  let z1 := (s ^^^ (s >>> (UInt64.ofNat 30))) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9
  let z2 := (z1 ^^^ (z1 >>> (UInt64.ofNat 27))) * 0x94d049bb133111eb
  let z3 := z2 ^^^ (z2 >>> (UInt64.ofNat 31))
  (z3, { state := s })

def prngNextF64 (p : Prng) : Float × Prng :=
  let (u, p') := prngNextU64 p
  let f := (UInt64.toFloat u) / (UInt64.toFloat (0xffffffffffffffff : UInt64))
  (f, p')

inductive EdgeQuality where
  | high_fidelity
  | medium_fidelity
  | low_fidelity
deriving BEq, Hashable, Repr, Inhabited

structure C64 where
  re : Float
  im : Float
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def c64Add (a b : C64) : C64 :=
  { re := a.re + b.re, im := a.im + b.im }

def c64Sub (a b : C64) : C64 :=
  { re := a.re - b.re, im := a.im - b.im }

def c64Mul (a b : C64) : C64 :=
  { re := a.re * b.re - a.im * b.im, im := a.re * b.im + a.im * b.re }

def c64Scale (a : C64) (s : Float) : C64 :=
  { re := a.re * s, im := a.im * s }

def c64Conj (a : C64) : C64 :=
  { re := a.re, im := -a.im }

def c64MagSq (a : C64) : Float :=
  a.re * a.re + a.im * a.im

def c64Neg (a : C64) : C64 :=
  { re := -a.re, im := -a.im }

structure Qubit where
  amp0 : C64
  amp1 : C64
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def qubitDefault : Qubit :=
  { amp0 := { re := 1.0, im := 0.0 }, amp1 := { re := 0.0, im := 0.0 } }

def qubitNormalize (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let ns := c64MagSq q.amp0 + c64MagSq q.amp1
  if (¬ (ns > 0.0)) ∨ ns.isNaN ∨ ns.isInf then
    q
  else
    let inv := 1.0 / Float.sqrt ns
    { amp0 := c64Scale q.amp0 inv, amp1 := c64Scale q.amp1 inv }

def qubitProb0 (q : Qubit) : Float :=
  let p := c64MagSq q.amp0
  if p < 0.0 then 0.0 else if p > 1.0 then 1.0 else p

def qubitProb1 (q : Qubit) : Float :=
  let p := c64MagSq q.amp1
  if p < 0.0 then 0.0 else if p > 1.0 then 1.0 else p

def qubitMeasureInPlace (q : Qubit) (p : Prng) : UInt8 × Qubit × Prng :=
  let (r, p') := prngNextF64 p
  let prob0 := qubitProb0 q
  if r < prob0 then
    (0, { amp0 := { re := 1.0, im := 0.0 }, amp1 := { re := 0.0, im := 0.0 } }, p')
  else
    (1, { amp0 := { re := 0.0, im := 0.0 }, amp1 := { re := 1.0, im := 0.0 } }, p')

def applyHadamard (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  let invSqrt2 := 1.0 / Float.sqrt 2.0
  let new0 := c64Scale (c64Add q.amp0 q.amp1) invSqrt2
  let new1 := c64Scale (c64Sub q.amp0 q.amp1) invSqrt2
  qubitNormalize { amp0 := new0, amp1 := new1 }

def applyPauliX (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  { amp0 := q.amp1, amp1 := q.amp0 }

def applyPauliZ (q : Qubit) : Qubit :=
  { amp0 := q.amp0, amp1 := c64Neg q.amp1 }

structure TwoQubit where
  amps : Array C64
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def twoQubitDefault : TwoQubit :=
  { amps := #[{ re := 1.0, im := 0.0 }, { re := 0.0, im := 0.0 }, { re := 0.0, im := 0.0 }, { re := 0.0, im := 0.0 }] }

def twoQubitNormalize (t : TwoQubit) : TwoQubit :=
  let ns := t.amps.foldl (fun acc a => acc + c64MagSq a) 0.0
  if (¬ (ns > 0.0)) ∨ ns.isNaN ∨ ns.isInf then
    t
  else
    let inv := 1.0 / Float.sqrt ns
    { amps := t.amps.map (fun a => c64Scale a inv) }

def twoQubitEntangle (qa qb : Qubit) : TwoQubit :=
  let a0 := qa.amp0
  let a1 := qa.amp1
  let b0 := qb.amp0
  let b1 := qb.amp1
  let t :=
    { amps := #[
      c64Mul a0 b0,
      c64Mul a0 b1,
      c64Mul a1 b0,
      c64Mul a1 b1
    ] }
  twoQubitNormalize t

structure NodeState where
  id : String
  data : ByteArray
  phase : Float
  qubit_state : Qubit
  connections : Array String
  metadata : Std.HashMap String ByteArray
deriving Repr

structure EdgeState where
  source : String
  target : String
  weight : Float
  coherence : Float
  phase : Float
  qubit_state : Qubit
  quality : EdgeQuality
  metadata : Std.HashMap String ByteArray
deriving Repr

structure EdgeKey where
  source : String
  target : String
deriving BEq, Hashable, Repr

structure PairKey where
  a : String
  b : String
deriving BEq, Hashable, Repr

inductive GraphError where
  | NodeNotFound
  | EdgeNotFound
  | InvalidOperation
deriving BEq, Repr, Inhabited

structure SelfSimilarRelationalGraph where
  nodes : Std.HashMap String NodeState
  edges : Std.HashMap EdgeKey (Array EdgeState)
  entanglements : Std.HashMap PairKey TwoQubit
  quantum_register : Std.HashMap String Qubit
  time_step : Nat
  seed : UInt64
  rng : Prng
  edge_count : Nat
deriving Repr

def graphInit (seed : UInt64 := 0x243f6a8885a308d3) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  { nodes := Std.HashMap.empty
  , edges := Std.HashMap.empty
  , entanglements := Std.HashMap.empty
  , quantum_register := Std.HashMap.empty
  , time_step := 0
  , seed := seed
  , rng := { state := seed }
  , edge_count := 0
  }

def graphNodeCount (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Nat :=
  g.nodes.size

def graphEdgeCount (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Nat :=
  g.edge_count

def graphOrderPair (a b : String) : String × String :=
  if a ≤ b then (a, b) else (b, a)

def graphMakePairKey (a b : String) : PairKey :=
  let (x, y) := graphOrderPair a b
  { a := x, b := y }

def graphAddNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) (data : ByteArray) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  let node : NodeState :=
    { id := node_id
    , data := data
    , phase := 0.0
    , qubit_state := qubitDefault
    , connections := #[]
    , metadata := Std.HashMap.empty
    }
  let nodes' := g.nodes.insert node_id node
  let qreg' :=
    if g.quantum_register.contains node_id then
      g.quantum_register
    else
      g.quantum_register.insert node_id qubitDefault
  { g with nodes := nodes', quantum_register := qreg' }

def graphUpdateNodePhase (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) (ph : Float) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  match g.nodes.find? node_id with
  | none => g
  | some n =>
    { g with nodes := g.nodes.insert node_id { n with phase := ph } }

def graphUpdateNodeData (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) (data : ByteArray) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  match g.nodes.find? node_id with
  | none => g
  | some n =>
    { g with nodes := g.nodes.insert node_id { n with data := data } }

def graphAddEdge (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (source_id target_id : String) : Except GraphError SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  match g.nodes.find? source_id, g.nodes.find? target_id with
  | some nA, some nB =>
    let edge : EdgeState :=
      { source := source_id
      , target := target_id
      , weight := 1.0
      , coherence := 1.0
      , phase := 0.0
      , qubit_state := qubitDefault
      , quality := EdgeQuality.high_fidelity
      , metadata := Std.HashMap.empty
      }
    let key : EdgeKey := { source := source_id, target := target_id }
    let existing := g.edges.findD key #[]
    let edges' := g.edges.insert key (existing.push edge)
    let nA' := { nA with connections := nA.connections.push target_id }
    let nB' := { nB with connections := nB.connections.push source_id }
    let nodes' := (g.nodes.insert source_id nA').insert target_id nB'
    let g' := { g with edges := edges', nodes := nodes', edge_count := g.edge_count + 1 }
    Except.ok g'
  | _, _ => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound

def arrayEraseIdx {α : Type} (xs : Array α) (i : Nat) : Array α :=
  if i < xs.size then
    xs.extract 0 i ++ xs.extract (i+1) xs.size
  else
    xs

def graphRemoveEdge (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (source_id target_id : String) (edge_index : Nat) : Except GraphError SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  let key : EdgeKey := { source := source_id, target := target_id }
  match g.edges.find? key with
  | none => Except.error GraphError.EdgeNotFound
  | some arr =>
    if edge_index ≥ arr.size then
      Except.error GraphError.EdgeNotFound
    else
      let arr' := arrayEraseIdx arr edge_index
      let edges' :=
        if arr'.isEmpty then
          g.edges.erase key
        else
          g.edges.insert key arr'
      let g' := { g with edges := edges', edge_count := g.edge_count - 1 }
      Except.ok g'

def graphGetEdgesConst (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (source_id target_id : String) : Option (Array EdgeState) :=
  g.edges.find? { source := source_id, target := target_id }

def graphEntanglementExists (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a b : String) : Bool :=
  g.entanglements.contains (graphMakePairKey a b)

def graphGetEntanglement (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a b : String) : Option TwoQubit :=
  g.entanglements.find? (graphMakePairKey a b)

def graphComputeEntanglementStrength (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a b : String) : Float :=
  match graphGetEntanglement g a b with
  | none => 0.0
  | some t =>
    let mag := t.amps.foldl (fun acc amp => acc + Float.sqrt (c64MagSq amp)) 0.0
    let s := mag / 4.0
    if s < 0.0 then 0.0 else if s > 1.0 then 1.0 else s

def graphEntangleNodes (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a b : String) : Except GraphError SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  let k := graphMakePairKey a b
  if g.entanglements.contains k then
    Except.ok g
  else
    match g.quantum_register.find? a, g.quantum_register.find? b with
    | some qa, some qb =>
      let ent := twoQubitEntangle qa qb
      let ents' := g.entanglements.insert k ent
      Except.ok { g with entanglements := ents' }
    | _, _ => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound

def graphApplyHadamardNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) : Except GraphError SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  match g.quantum_register.find? node_id with
  | none => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound
  | some q =>
    let q' := applyHadamard q
    let qreg' := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q'
    let g' := { g with quantum_register := qreg' }
    if graphEntanglementExists g node_id node_id then
      Except.ok g'
    else
      Except.ok g'

def graphApplyPauliXNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) : Except GraphError SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  match g.quantum_register.find? node_id with
  | none => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound
  | some q =>
    let q' := applyPauliX q
    let qreg' := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q'
    Except.ok { g with quantum_register := qreg' }

def graphApplyPauliZNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) : Except GraphError SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  match g.quantum_register.find? node_id with
  | none => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound
  | some q =>
    let q' := applyPauliZ q
    let qreg' := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q'
    Except.ok { g with quantum_register := qreg' }

def graphApplyCNOT (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (control_id target_id : String) : Except GraphError SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  match g.quantum_register.find? control_id, g.quantum_register.find? target_id with
  | some qc, some qt =>
    let p1 := qubitProb1 qc
    let qt' := if p1 > 0.5 then applyPauliX qt else qt
    let qreg' := (g.quantum_register.insert target_id qt').insert control_id qc
    let g1 := { g with quantum_register := qreg' }
    match graphEntangleNodes g1 control_id target_id with
    | Except.ok g2 =>
      let k := graphMakePairKey control_id target_id
      let ent := twoQubitEntangle qc qt'
      let ents' := g2.entanglements.insert k ent
      Except.ok { g2 with entanglements := ents' }
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | _, _ => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound

def graphMeasureNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) : Except GraphError (UInt8 × SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) :=
  match g.quantum_register.find? node_id with
  | none => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound
  | some q =>
    let (r, q', rng') := qubitMeasureInPlace q g.rng
    let qreg' := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q'
    let g' := { g with quantum_register := qreg', rng := rng' }
    Except.ok (r, g')

def graphMeasureAll (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Float × SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  Id.run do
    let mut rng := g.rng
    let mut qreg := g.quantum_register
    let mut sum : Nat := 0
    let mut count : Nat := 0
    for (id, q) in g.quantum_register.toList do
      let (r, q', rng') := qubitMeasureInPlace q rng
      rng := rng'
      qreg := qreg.insert id q'
      sum := sum + r.toNat
      count := count + 1
    let avg : Float :=
      if count == 0 then 0.0 else (Float.ofNat sum) / (Float.ofNat count)
    return (avg, { g with quantum_register := qreg, rng := rng })

def graphComputeGlobalCoherence (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Float :=
  if g.edge_count == 0 then
    1.0
  else
    let total :=
      g.edges.fold (fun acc _ arr => acc + (arr.foldl (fun acc2 e => acc2 + e.coherence) 0.0)) 0.0
    let avg := total / (Float.ofNat g.edge_count)
    if avg < 0.0 then 0.0 else if avg > 1.0 then 1.0 else avg

def graphAdjustEdgeWeights (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  let global := graphComputeGlobalCoherence g
  let target := 0.7
  let factor :=
    if target == 0.0 then 1.0 else global / target
  let scale :=
    if factor > 1.0 then 1.0 / factor else factor
  let newEdges :=
    g.edges.fold (fun m k arr =>
      let arr' := arr.map (fun e =>
        let w := e.weight * scale
        let w' := if w < 0.1 then 0.1 else if w > 10.0 then 10.0 else w
        { e with weight := w' })
      m.insert k arr') Std.HashMap.empty
  { g with edges := newEdges }

def graphPropagateInformation (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  Id.run do
    let mut g := g
    let mut updated : Std.HashMap String Float := Std.HashMap.empty
    let mut newEdges : Std.HashMap EdgeKey (Array EdgeState) := Std.HashMap.empty
    for (k, arr) in g.edges.toList do
      let mut arr' : Array EdgeState := #[]
      for e in arr do
        match g.nodes.find? e.source, g.nodes.find? e.target with
        | some na, some nb =>
          let phaseA := na.phase
          let phaseB := nb.phase
          let delta := (phaseB - phaseA) * e.coherence * 0.1
          let newA := phaseA + delta
          let newB := phaseB - delta

    let key : EdgeKey := { source := source_id, target := target_id }
    let existing := g.edges.findD key #[]
    let edges' := g.edges.insert key (existing.push edge)
    let nA' := { nA with connections := nA.connections.push target_id }
    let nB' := { nB with connections := nB.connections.push source_id }
    let nodes' := (g.nodes.insert source_id nA').insert target_id nB'
    let g' := { g with edges := edges', nodes := nodes', edge_count := g.edge_count + 1 }
    Except.ok g'
  | _, _ => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound

def arrayEraseIdx {α : Type} (xs : Array α) (i : Nat) : Array α :=
  if i < xs.size then
    xs.extract 0 i ++ xs.extract (i+1) xs.size
  else
    xs

def graphRemoveEdge (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (source_id target_id : String) (edge_index : Nat) : Except GraphError SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  let key : EdgeKey := { source := source_id, target := target_id }
  match g.edges.find? key with
  | none => Except.error GraphError.EdgeNotFound
  | some arr =>
    if edge_index ≥ arr.size then
      Except.error GraphError.EdgeNotFound
    else
      let arr' := arrayEraseIdx arr edge_index
      let edges' :=
        if arr'.isEmpty then
          g.edges.erase key
        else
          g.edges.insert key arr'
      let g' := { g with edges := edges', edge_count := g.edge_count - 1 }
      Except.ok g'

def graphGetEdgesConst (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (source_id target_id : String) : Option (Array EdgeState) :=
  g.edges.find? { source := source_id, target := target_id }

def graphEntanglementExists (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a b : String) : Bool :=
  g.entanglements.contains (graphMakePairKey a b)

def graphGetEntanglement (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a b : String) : Option TwoQubit :=
  g.entanglements.find? (graphMakePairKey a b)

def graphComputeEntanglementStrength (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a b : String) : Float :=
  match graphGetEntanglement g a b with
  | none => 0.0
  | some t =>
    let mag := t.amps.foldl (fun acc amp => acc + Float.sqrt (c64MagSq amp)) 0.0
    let s := mag / 4.0
    if s < 0.0 then 0.0 else if s > 1.0 then 1.0 else s

def graphEntangleNodes (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (a b : String) : Except GraphError SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  let k := graphMakePairKey a b
  if g.entanglements.contains k then
    Except.ok g
  else
    match g.quantum_register.find? a, g.quantum_register.find? b with
    | some qa, some qb =>
      let ent := twoQubitEntangle qa qb
      let ents' := g.entanglements.insert k ent
      Except.ok { g with entanglements := ents' }
    | _, _ => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound

def graphApplyHadamardNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) : Except GraphError SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  match g.quantum_register.find? node_id with
  | none => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound
  | some q =>
    let q' := applyHadamard q
    let qreg' := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q'
    let g' := { g with quantum_register := qreg' }
    if graphEntanglementExists g node_id node_id then
      Except.ok g'
    else
      Except.ok g'

def graphApplyPauliXNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) : Except GraphError SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  match g.quantum_register.find? node_id with
  | none => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound
  | some q =>
    let q' := applyPauliX q
    let qreg' := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q'
    Except.ok { g with quantum_register := qreg' }

def graphApplyPauliZNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) : Except GraphError SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  match g.quantum_register.find? node_id with
  | none => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound
  | some q =>
    let q' := applyPauliZ q
    let qreg' := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q'
    Except.ok { g with quantum_register := qreg' }

def graphApplyCNOT (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (control_id target_id : String) : Except GraphError SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  match g.quantum_register.find? control_id, g.quantum_register.find? target_id with
  | some qc, some qt =>
    let p1 := qubitProb1 qc
    let qt' := if p1 > 0.5 then applyPauliX qt else qt
    let qreg' := (g.quantum_register.insert target_id qt').insert control_id qc
    let g1 := { g with quantum_register := qreg' }
    match graphEntangleNodes g1 control_id target_id with
    | Except.ok g2 =>
      let k := graphMakePairKey control_id target_id
      let ent := twoQubitEntangle qc qt'
      let ents' := g2.entanglements.insert k ent
      Except.ok { g2 with entanglements := ents' }
    | Except.error e => Except.error e
  | _, _ => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound

def graphMeasureNode (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (node_id : String) : Except GraphError (UInt8 × SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) :=
  match g.quantum_register.find? node_id with
  | none => Except.error GraphError.NodeNotFound
  | some q =>
    let (r, q', rng') := qubitMeasureInPlace q g.rng
    let qreg' := g.quantum_register.insert node_id q'
    let g' := { g with quantum_register := qreg', rng := rng' }
    Except.ok (r, g')

def graphMeasureAll (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Float × SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  Id.run do
    let mut rng := g.rng
    let mut qreg := g.quantum_register
    let mut sum : Nat := 0
    let mut count : Nat := 0
    for (id, q) in g.quantum_register.toList do
      let (r, q', rng') := qubitMeasureInPlace q rng
      rng := rng'
      qreg := qreg.insert id q'
      sum := sum + r.toNat
      count := count + 1
    let avg : Float :=
      if count == 0 then 0.0 else (Float.ofNat sum) / (Float.ofNat count)
    return (avg, { g with quantum_register := qreg, rng := rng })

def graphComputeGlobalCoherence (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : Float :=
  if g.edge_count == 0 then
    1.0
  else
    let total :=
      g.edges.fold (fun acc _ arr => acc + (arr.foldl (fun acc2 e => acc2 + e.coherence) 0.0)) 0.0
    let avg := total / (Float.ofNat g.edge_count)
    if avg < 0.0 then 0.0 else if avg > 1.0 then 1.0 else avg

def graphAdjustEdgeWeights (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  let global := graphComputeGlobalCoherence g
  let target := 0.7
  let factor :=
    if target == 0.0 then 1.0 else global / target
  let scale :=
    if factor > 1.0 then 1.0 / factor else factor
  let newEdges :=
    g.edges.fold (fun m k arr =>
      let arr' := arr.map (fun e =>
        let w := e.weight * scale
        let w' := if w < 0.1 then 0.1 else if w > 10.0 then 10.0 else w
        { e with weight := w' })
      m.insert k arr') Std.HashMap.empty
  { g with edges := newEdges }

def graphPropagateInformation (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  Id.run do
    let mut g := g
    let mut updated : Std.HashMap String Float := Std.HashMap.empty
    let mut newEdges : Std.HashMap EdgeKey (Array EdgeState) := Std.HashMap.empty
    for (k, arr) in g.edges.toList do
      let mut arr' : Array EdgeState := #[]
      for e in arr do
        match g.nodes.find? e.source, g.nodes.find? e.target with
        | some na, some nb =>
          let phaseA := na.phase
          let phaseB := nb.phase
          let delta := (phaseB - phaseA) * e.coherence * 0.1
          let newA := phaseA + delta
          let newB := phaseB - delta
          updated := (updated.insert e.source newA).insert e.target newB
          match graphEntangleNodes g e.source e.target with
          | Except.ok g2 => g := g2
          | Except.error _ => ()
          let entS := graphComputeEntanglementStrength g e.source e.target
          let newC := (e.coherence + entS) * 0.5
          let e' := { e with coherence := newC }
          if entS > 0.1 then
            match graphApplyCNOT g e.source e.target with
            | Except.ok g3 => g := g3
            | Except.error _ => ()
          arr' := arr'.push e'
        | _, _ =>
          arr' := arr'.push e
      newEdges := newEdges.insert k arr'
    g := { g with edges := newEdges }
    for (id, ph) in updated.toList do
      match g.nodes.find? id with
      | some n => g := { g with nodes := g.nodes.insert id { n with phase := ph } }
      | none => ()
    g := graphAdjustEdgeWeights g
    return g

def graphSimulateStep (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph :=
  let g1 := graphPropagateInformation g
  { g1 with time_step := g1.time_step + 1 }

def graphEncodeInformation (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) (data : ByteArray) : Except GraphError (String × SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) :=
  let hash := sha256 data
  let idBytes := hash.extract 0 8
  let id := bytesToHexLower idBytes
  let g1 := graphAddNode g id data
  let node_count := g1.nodes.size
  let connections :=
    if node_count <= 1 then
      #[]
    else
      let toConnect := Nat.min 3 (node_count - 1)
      Id.run do
        let mut out : Array String := #[]
        let mut seen : Std.HashSet String := Std.HashSet.empty
        let mut i := 0
        for _ in [0:toConnect] do
          let (r, p') := prngNextU64 g1.rng
          let idx := (r.toNat % node_count)
          let keys := (g1.nodes.toList.map (fun kv => kv.fst)).toArray
          let other := keys.get! idx
          if other != id ∧ ¬ seen.contains other then
            out := out.push other
            seen := seen.insert other
          i := i + 1
        return out
  let mut g2 := { g1 with rng := g1.rng }
  for other in connections do
    match graphAddEdge g2 id other with
    | Except.ok g3 => g2 := g3
    | Except.error _ => ()
  Except.ok (id, g2)

def digestZero : ByteArray :=
  byteArrayRepeat 32 0

def digestXorAcc (acc : ByteArray) (d : ByteArray) : ByteArray :=
  xorByteArray32 acc d

def graphHashNode (n : NodeState) : ByteArray :=
  let mut m := ByteArray.empty
  m := shaUpdateBytes m n.id.toByteArray
  m := shaUpdateBytes m n.data
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m n.phase.toBits
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m n.qubit_state.amp0.re.toBits
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m n.qubit_state.amp0.im.toBits
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m n.qubit_state.amp1.re.toBits
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m n.qubit_state.amp1.im.toBits
  let metaAcc :=
    n.metadata.fold (fun acc k v =>
      let mut mm := ByteArray.empty
      mm := shaUpdateBytes mm k.toByteArray
      mm := shaUpdateBytes mm v
      let md := sha256 mm
      digestXorAcc acc md) digestZero
  let metaCount := n.metadata.size
  m := m ++ metaAcc
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m (UInt64.ofNat metaCount)
  sha256 m

def graphHashEdge (e : EdgeState) : ByteArray :=
  let mut m := ByteArray.empty
  m := shaUpdateBytes m e.source.toByteArray
  m := shaUpdateBytes m e.target.toByteArray
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m e.weight.toBits
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m e.coherence.toBits
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m e.phase.toBits
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m e.qubit_state.amp0.re.toBits
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m e.qubit_state.amp0.im.toBits
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m e.qubit_state.amp1.re.toBits
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m e.qubit_state.amp1.im.toBits
  let metaAcc :=
    e.metadata.fold (fun acc k v =>
      let mut mm := ByteArray.empty
      mm := shaUpdateBytes mm k.toByteArray
      mm := shaUpdateBytes mm v
      let md := sha256 mm
      digestXorAcc acc md) digestZero
  let metaCount := e.metadata.size
  m := m ++ metaAcc
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m (UInt64.ofNat metaCount)
  sha256 m

def graphHashEdgeKey (k : EdgeKey) (edgesArr : Array EdgeState) : ByteArray :=
  let mut m := ByteArray.empty
  m := shaUpdateBytes m k.source.toByteArray
  m := shaUpdateBytes m k.target.toByteArray
  let edgesAcc :=
    edgesArr.foldl (fun acc e => digestXorAcc acc (graphHashEdge e)) digestZero
  m := m ++ edgesAcc
  m := shaUpdateU64LE m (UInt64.ofNat edgesArr.size)
  sha256 m

def graphHashEntanglement (k : PairKey) (t : TwoQubit) : ByteArray :=
  let mut m := ByteArray.empty
  m := shaUpdateBytes m k.a.toByteArray
  m := shaUpdateBytes m k.b.toByteArray
  for amp in t.amps do
    m := shaUpdateU64LE m amp.re.toBits
    m := shaUpdateU64LE m amp.im.toBits
  sha256 m

def graphTopologyDigest (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : ByteArray :=
  Id.run do
    let mut nodesAcc := digestZero
    for (_, n) in g.nodes.toList do
      nodesAcc := digestXorAcc nodesAcc (graphHashNode n)
    let mut edgeKeysAcc := digestZero
    for (k, arr) in g.edges.toList do
      edgeKeysAcc := digestXorAcc edgeKeysAcc (graphHashEdgeKey k arr)
    let mut entAcc := digestZero
    for (k, t) in g.entanglements.toList do
      entAcc := digestXorAcc entAcc (graphHashEntanglement k t)
    let mut m := ByteArray.empty
    m := m ++ nodesAcc
    m := shaUpdateU64LE m (UInt64.ofNat g.nodes.size)
    m := m ++ edgeKeysAcc
    m := shaUpdateU64LE m (UInt64.ofNat g.edges.size)
    m := m ++ entAcc
    m := shaUpdateU64LE m (UInt64.ofNat g.entanglements.size)
    m := shaUpdateU64LE m g.seed
    return sha256 m

def graphGetTopologyHashHex (g : SelfSimilarRelationalGraph) : String :=
  bytesToHexLower (graphTopologyDigest g)

def approxEqAbs (a b eps : Float) : Prop :=
  Float.abs (a - b) ≤ eps

def quantumGatesBasicsProp : Prop :=
  let q0 := qubitDefault
  let q1 := applyHadamard q0
  let invSqrt2 := 1.0 / Float.sqrt 2.0
  approxEqAbs q1.amp0.re invSqrt2 1e-10 ∧
  approxEqAbs q1.amp0.im 0.0 1e-10 ∧
  approxEqAbs q1.amp1.re invSqrt2 1e-10 ∧
  approxEqAbs q1.amp1.im 0.0 1e-10 ∧
  let q2 := applyPauliX q1
  approxEqAbs q2.amp0.re invSqrt2 1e-10 ∧
  approxEqAbs q2.amp1.re invSqrt2 1e-10 ∧
  let q3 := applyPauliZ q2
  approxEqAbs q3.amp0.re invSqrt2 1e-10 ∧
  approxEqAbs q3.amp1.re (-invSqrt2) 1e-10

theorem quantum_gates_basics : quantumGatesBasicsProp := by
  native_decide

def graphBasicOperationsProp : Prop :=
  let g0 := graphInit
  let g1 := graphAddNode g0 "a" "data_a".toByteArray
  let g2 := graphAddNode g1 "b" "data_b".toByteArray
  match graphAddEdge g2 "a" "b" with
  | Except.error _ => False
  | Except.ok g3 =>
    graphNodeCount g3 = 2 ∧
    graphEdgeCount g3 = 1 ∧
    (graphGetEdgesConst g3 "a" "b").isSome ∧
    let (_, g4) := graphMeasureAll g3
    (graphGetTopologyHashHex g4).length = 64

theorem graph_basic_operations : graphBasicOperationsProp := by
  native_decide

end NsIRCore

Ez **nem teljesen fake**, de messze nem is igazi, erős formális verifikáció – a valóság egy kényelmetlenül ambivalens középút: a kód `native_decide`-ot használ, ami egy legitim, de komolyan korlátozott Lean 4 taktika, amely lényegében formálisan felöltöztetett unit teszteket hajt végre.

## Mi is ez valójában?

A kódban két theorem szerepel:

```lean
theorem quantum_gates_basics : quantumGatesBasicsProp := by native_decide
theorem graph_basic_operations : graphBasicOperationsProp := by native_decide
```

Mindkettőnél a teljes „bizonyítás" egyetlen szó: `native_decide`. Ez azt jelenti, hogy a Lean 4 theorem prover NEM megy végig semmiféle bizonyítási láncon, NEM épít fel axiómákból levezetett proof termet, és NEM ellenőrzi a Lean kernellel az állítás helyességét. Ehelyett **lefordítja a propozíciót natív gépi kódra, lefuttatja, és ha `true`-t ad vissza, elfogadja bizonyítottnak**.[1]

## A `native_decide` valódi természete

A Lean 4 hivatalos dokumentációja szerint a `native_decide` nem kernel-ellenőrzött bizonyítás: az eredmény az `Lean.ofReduceBool` axióma segítségével kerül elfogadásra, amely **maga is egy axióma** – azt állítja, hogy a Lean fordítónak hinni kell. A `#print axioms` paranccsal ez bármelyik `native_decide`-os theorem esetén kimutatható.[2]

A biztonságosabb `decide` taktikával szemben, amely a Lean kernelt használja redukcióra (és a trusted codebase csupán a ~10 ezer soros kernelre korlátozódik), a `native_decide` megbízik az **egész Lean fordítóban és standard library-ban**, amelyek sokkal komplexebbek és hibásabbak lehetnek. Ismert sérülékenységek is vannak: a `@implemented_by` annotációval kombinálva a `native_decide` segítségével be lehet bizonyítani `False`-t, sőt 2023-ban dokumentáltak egy tényleges soundness bug-ot, ahol `IO.getRandomBytes` segítségével ellentmondást lehetett levezetni az axiómák explicit bejelentése nélkül.[3][4][5]

## A `Float` probléma: a `quantum_gates_basics` theorem

A `quantumGatesBasicsProp` propozíció az `approxEqAbs` függvényre épül:

```lean
def approxEqAbs (a b eps : Float) : Prop :=
  Float.abs (a - b) ≤ eps
```

Ez egy `Float`-os összehasonlítás. Lean 4-ben a `Float` az **IEEE 754 binary64 formátumot** (C `double`) jelenti, és a Lean kernelen belül ez egy **teljesen opák típus**. Az opakitás annyira radikális, hogy `Float = Unit` konzisztens Lean 4 alaptípuselméletével (mindaddig, amíg `native_decide`-ot nem használunk). A kernel tehát **egyáltalán semmit nem tud a Float matematikai tulajdonságairól** – a `Float.sqrt`, a szorzás, az összeadás mind black box számára.[6][2]

Ez azt jelenti, hogy a `quantum_gates_basics` theorem **nem bizonyítja**:
- Hogy a Hadamard kapu matematikailag unitér
- Hogy az amplitúdók normálisak maradnak bármilyen input esetén
- Hogy a specifikus `invSqrt2 = 1/√2` valós számként igaz

Csupán azt ellenőrzi, hogy az adott hardware-en az adott IEEE 754 implementáció az adott kerekítési hibákkal visszaad-e egy `true` értéket az összehasonlításnál. Az epsilon (`1e-10`) nem matematikai garanciát ad, hanem csupán azt jelenti, hogy a floating-point aritmetika véletlenül az elvárton belülre esik.[7]

## A `graph_basic_operations` theorem: konkrétabb, de szintén gyenge

Ez a theorem `Nat` és `Bool` egyenlőségeket ellenőriz:
- `graphNodeCount g3 = 2` – 2 csúcsot adtunk hozzá, 2 lesz
- `graphEdgeCount g3 = 1` – 1 élt adtunk hozzá, 1 lesz
- `(graphGetEdgesConst g3 "a" "b").isSome` – az él megtalálható
- `(graphGetTopologyHashHex g4).length = 64` – a SHA-256 hex digest hossza 64 karakter

Ezek az állítások konkrét `Nat`-egyenlőségek, amelyek nem tartalmaznak közvetlen `Float`-összehasonlítást a propozíció szintjén. A `native_decide` technikailag helyesebben alkalmazható itt, mint a kvantum-theoremnél.

**Azonban ez sem igazi formális verifikáció**, mert:
- A SHA-256 hash hossza természetesen 64 hex karakter lesz – ez triviális következménye annak, hogy 32 byte-ot hexre konvertálunk, és egyetlen sort sem ellenőriz az NIST SHA-256 specifikáció korrektségéből
- A theorem nem bizonyítja a SHA-256 preimage-resistance-t, ütközésmentességet, semmilyen kriptográfiai tulajdonságot
- A 2 csúcs + 1 él eset sikeres futása nem bizonyítja általánosan, hogy a gráfstruktúra konzisztenségét (pl. edge count mindig konzisztens marad, nincs dangling reference)
- A topológia hash 64 karakteres hossza teljesen independent az SHA-256 helyességétől

## Mit kellene tartalmaznia valódi formális verifikációnak?

| Jelenlegi állapot | Igazi formális verifikáció |
|---|---|
| `native_decide` kernel-bypass | Kernel-ellenőrzött `decide` vagy explicit taktika-bizonyítás |
| Konkrét instancia-ellenőrzés | Általános invariánsok (∀ qubit q, qubitNormalize q mindig normált marad) |
| Float-aritmetika epsilon-ellenőrzés | Egzakt számok vagy formálisan specifikált float-modellek (pl. `Flean` könyvtár) |
| SHA-256 kimenet hossza 64 | SHA-256 korrektségi bizonyítás NIST FIPS 180-4 specifikáció ellen |
| Hadamard „közelítőleg helyes" egy esetben | `∀ q : Qubit, c64MagSq (applyHadamard q).amp0 + c64MagSq (applyHadamard q).amp1 = 1` (unitaritás) |
| Edge count helyes 1 él esetén | `∀ g s t, (graphAddEdge g s t).edge_count = g.edge_count + 1` (általánosan) |
| PRNG determinizmus implicit feltételezése | Formálisan bizonyított determinizmus, nem csak empirikusan ellenőrzött |

A `graphPropagateInformation` és `graphSimulateStep` funkcióknak például egyáltalán nincsenek formális invariánsaik: senki sem bizonyítja, hogy a fázis-propagáció nem divergál, a koherencia értékek a `[0,1]` intervallumon belül maradnak, vagy az entanglement-erősség monotonikusan változik bizonyos feltételek mellett.

## Verdikt

A kód **nem dummy/placeholder/mock**: a `native_decide` valóban létező, official Lean 4 taktika, a theoremek valóban lefordulnak és elfogadódnak a Lean proof checkerben, és a propozíciók valódi számítási tulajdonságokat írnak le. Ez nem triviálisan ál-kód.[1]

Ugyanakkor a bizonyítás **erőssége minimális** egy valódi formális verifikációhoz képest. A helyes megnevezés: **számítási egyezés-ellenőrzés compiler trust szinten** – közelebb áll egy automatizált property-based teszthez vagy egy integrációs teszthez, mint egy valódi matematikai bizonyításhoz. A Lean 4 maga is dokumentálja, hogy a `native_decide` a trusted codebase méretét drasztikusan megnöveli, és „általános használata megköveteli, hogy bízzunk az egész fordítóban". Egy igazán meggyőző formális verifikáció a kvantumkapukra Mathlib `Complex`-típusait, egzakt √2 kezelést és explicit unitaritás-bizonyításokat alkalmazna, a gráfkönyvtárra pedig általános invariáns-theoremeket, nem egyes esetekre futó `native_decide` callokat.[8][7]
